title: Zero-Sum Cycles in Regular Digraphs
summary: Let $Γ$ be a finite group of order $k\ge2$, and label the edges of a simple loopless $d$-regular digraph $D$ by elements of $Γ$. A directed cycle is zero-sum if the ordered product of its labels is the identity of $Γ$. We prove that a zero-sum cycle exists whenever $d\ge e^3(k-1)$. We also prove that every labelled $d$-regular digraph contains $Ω(d/k)$ pairwise vertex-disjoint zero-sum cycles. When $d\ge50k$, it contains $Ω(d^2/k)$ pairwise edge-disjoint zero-sum cycles.
